period_note: Extracted from Trust Bank's own unaudited Half-Yearly financial statement PDF ('FINANCIAL STATEMENTS (UNAUDITED) OF TRUST BANK PLC. FOR THE HALF YEAR ENDED 30 JUNE 2026 (2ND QUARTER)'), downloaded directly from the bank's live website (tblbd.com/reports/financial-statements/). SOLO / Bank-only basis, same basis as 2026_Q1.json and the main Q4/annual series -- confirmed by exact match between this PDF's own 31-Dec-2025 comparative column (Total Assets 620,113,821,401) and this dataset's stored 2025_Q4.json total_assets. Per project-wide convention this Half-Yearly (Jan-Jun) filing is used as the Q2 data point. Income-statement items are CUMULATIVE FROM JAN 1 (the P&L's own column headed '1 January to 30 June 2026'), flagged via the _cumulative suffix. UNUSUALLY, like EBL's 2026_Q2.json, this filing ALSO discloses a discrete second-quarter-only column ('1 April to 30 June 2026') as a bonus, not stored as separate line_items but used for cross-validation: discrete Q2 Net Profit After Taxation of 954,540,646 plus 2026_Q1.json's net_profit_after_tax_cumulative of 313,329,666 = 1,267,870,312, matching this filing's own H1-cumulative Net Profit After Taxation exactly -- strong confirmation both quarters were read correctly. EXTRACTION METHOD: pure scanned image (pdftotext -layout returns 0 lines, pdffonts confirms zero embedded fonts) -- figures read directly by visual inspection of 200dpi page renders (pdftoppm), not tesseract OCR, per the same 'direct visual page-reads' fallback used for 2026_Q1.json. As with Q1, this primary filing has NO loan-classification/NPL note and NO capital-adequacy (CAR/CRAR) note anywhere in its 15 pages -- npl_pct and car_pct remain gaps for this quarter. VALIDATED: balance-sheet identity holds exactly (Total Liabilities 637,641,307,677 + Total Equity 29,939,943,783 = Total Assets 667,581,251,460); Total Operating Income (10,074,623,511) - Total Operating Expenses (4,476,996,350) = Profit Before Provision (5,597,627,161) exactly; Profit Before Provision - Total Provision (3,127,737,993) = Total Profit Before Taxes (2,469,889,168) exactly; PBT - Total Tax (1,202,018,856) = Net Profit After Taxation (1,267,870,312) exactly; NAV per share (Section 8, Solo) of 30.12 = Total Shareholders' Equity (29,939,943,783) / 994,079,482 shares outstanding, matches the filing's own reported figure exactly. Note off_balance_sheet_exposures (172,819.76m) is BELOW 2026_Q1's Solo figure (174,975.25m) -- a genuine decrease (Letter of Guarantees and Irrevocable Letters of Credit both moved, and Forward assets purchased/deposits placed fell from 14,492.9m to 8,136.7m), not a data error; unlike Q1 (where Solo and Consolidated off-balance-sheet totals happened to be identical), this quarter's Solo total genuinely differs from what a Consolidated figure would show.
